title: Enforce live PI permissions and customer scope through sales order conversion
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add reusable Application PI authorization and complete controller coverage for list/detail/create/update/submit/approve/unaudit/cancel/void/delete/batch and print/order-prefill/to-order. Require live enabled identity and existing proforma-invoice menu/customer scope before counts, numbering, reads/writes. Conversion additionally requires existing sales-order authority and target customer in scope, never grants target rights from source access. Verify both original and proposed customer on updates, unknown/unowned customers fail closed per existing scope convention. No new menu grants or schema, preserve legacy business permissions for genuinely authorized users.

Actual controller SQL own/foreign/revoked/disabled/no identity and source-only/target-only conversion denial; denied batch/conversion/update preserves source/target status, details, money and number/audit evidence. Keep original calculation/deposit/currency/unit and existing conversion eligibility; bounded scope before paging/export and no hidden field disclosure. Update affected existing unit fixtures to genuine existing authorized identities only, safe Release/full unit and relevant existing conversion regressions; browser evidence or exact blocker.

implementation_evidence: ProformaInvoiceController uses inherited ResolveScopeAsync on selected reads but create/update/approve/unaudit/void/to-order paths do not explicitly recheck enabled identity and existing PI menu. ToSalesOrder loads source and calls conversion then writes target without a live source/target menu check.
